title: ucw-2006-world
label: The First

won.source: The Elimination Chamber write-up of Scars and Stripes, posted 13 September 2006 ('new UCW Champion, The First').

how: Won the title by winning the Elimination Chamber match over Irishred, Dan Ryan, Cameron Cruise, Joey Melton and Jonathan Marx.
note: Still champion at Night of the Legends II in February 2007 ('STILL UCW World Champion, The First') and defending against Cameron Cruise and others; no change of title is held.

title: ucw-2006-world
label: The First

won.source: The owner's UCW Title Histories thread of 13 July 2006 (edited after Scars and Stripes: it names that show's results). It lists 'The First' as the first UCW World Title holder.

lost.source: The 17 June 2006 show has The First demanding a rematch for 'the UCW Title' he used to own; Irishred is the champion.

how: The first UCW World Heavyweight Champion by the owner's title history.
note: No won-date survives: the reign belongs to the fed's earlier run on another board.

title: ucw-2006-world
label: Irishred

won.source: The owner's UCW Title Histories thread of 13 July 2006 (edited after Scars and Stripes: it names that show's results). It lists Irishred second.

lost.source: The Elimination Chamber match of Scars and Stripes, whose write-up was posted 13 September 2006: 'here is your winner and new UCW Champion, The First'.

how: Held the title from the fed's earlier run; his first defence at Civil War was against Jonathan Marx in a parking-lot brawl, which he retained.
note: The reign ended at Scars and Stripes.

title: ucw-2006-united-states
label: Adam Benjamin

won.source: The Civil War write-up (June 2006): 'here is your winner and new United States Champion, Adam Benjamin'.

lost.source: Scars and Stripes (write-up posted 13 September 2006): Bryan Storms 'is the new UCW US Champion'.

how: Won the first UCW United States Championship in a four-way match over Damon Blackburn, AJ Cirrus and Beau Michaels.
note: He retained it on 17 June and 6 August 2006.

title: ucw-2006-united-states
label: Bryan Storms

won.source: The Scars and Stripes write-up posted 13 September 2006.

lost.source: The 'November 18th Revolution' write-up: 'Winner and new UCW United States Champion: Dakota Smith'.

how: Won the title from Adam Benjamin, with Mr. Incredible as special guest referee, after turning on MCW.
note: His first defence was against Dakota Smith.

title: ucw-2006-united-states
label: Dakota Smith
how: Won the title from Bryan Storms, his former MCW teammate.
note: He kept it by disqualification against The Sergeant at Night of the Legends II and was announced to defend against BG Bruce on 24 March 2007; no change is held.

title: ucw-2006-lvw
label: Irishred

won.source: Night of the Legends II (posted 12 February 2007).

how: Won the LVW title in the anything-goes match and spray-painted it as the B4B Championship.
note: He kept it against Cameron Cruise ('B4B champion') on 10 March 2007.

title: ucw-2006-lvw
label: Jimmy Donovan

won.source: The owner's Revolution of 6 August 2006 (commissioner's announcement) names 'LVW Champion Cowboy James Donovan'.

lost.source: Night of the Legends II (write-up posted 12 February 2007): 'Irishred is the new LVW Champion'.

how: Held the LVW World Heavyweight Championship before and after UCW's purchase of LVW in August 2006.
note: The champion at the purchase; the date he won it is not held.
